text_block_list.text:
One day, as I walked carrying a huge stack of books
to brainstorm our team training—
A strong gust of wind threw me off balance, and I dropped the book...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly...
You sure manage to pull off some classic blunders, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If you're carrying a large amount, tie it down.
First of all, don't carry an impossible load.
Your risk management is lacking.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"It's a relief no students were around,
but what would you have done if someone got hurt?!"

Thinking I should quickly pick them up, I bent down,
and Acting President Kashimoto began gathering the books as well.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The more hands, the better.
Look, there are some dropped over there too.
Acting Principal Kashimoto efficiently gathered the books and handed them over neatly...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Also, regarding the sticky note on the book,
there's a typo. The radical for "懸" is the heart radical.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You are the closest adult who ought to serve as a role model for the Umamusume, so I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll be on my way.
Acting Principal Kashimoto walked away coolly.

She seemed so cold and detached at first...
but maybe she's surprisingly kind deep down.

—In any case, without losing the book,
I was able to put together a solid training routine.
